The demon that fell from Heaven that ravages his own kind. The immensely powerful mononoke that could rival Ragou in potential: Amagi. The so-called friend of Ragou, Amagi and him have had a long history dating back to the Edo period. Notorious amongst ancient mononoke for his abilities, most of which are not in praise. Unlike all the other mononoke, Amagi has a ability that makes him much more powerful than most, at the cost of it being taboo. On top of everything, he has his own following with its own ideology.

Amagi radiates a gentleman-like vibe when first meeting fellow mononoke; however, he will show a cocky side upon disagreement. Moreover, should things not go his way, Amagi will begin to threaten others and even get violent. With his taboo ability, it makes him merciless to everyone, mononoke or not. Because of this, he is somewhat feared by others of his kind.

As Amagi has amassed a large following, he has further power to wield. His vision is to make mononoke be praised and worshiped like gods as they once were. To achieve this, he utilizes his following to instigate attacks, cause chaos, and lure those he needs to an area. The key to his vision is Ragou, as Amagi needs him for his vision to become reality. ~!The power that Amagi has is like no other mononoke. He is able to cannibalize his own kind to gain further power as a mononoke. In his days of being worshipped, Amagi avoided eating others, but he later did as he could not defend his sanctioned land at his current ability back then. He later learned he could eat his own kind to become even stronger.!~ ~!In the end, Amagi uses all of his following to become more powerful by ruthlessly killing and devouring them. He even is willing to devour Kouga, partly his own creation, but doesn't in order to lure Jirou Azuma. Afterwards, Amagi is put to rest by the combined effort of Jirou and Ragou.!~

node.description:
The ruler of Avidya Forest and long living mononoke: Ogre Lord Ibuki. Notably known for threatening death over those that enter her forest, Ibuki is rather territorial with her domain. Though she says such things, she isn't as violent as she lets on. Instead, she just wishes to protect her land from any harm, be it from mononoke or humans. Even with her territorial nature, Ibuki has managed to get a husband, Monjumaru that she's been with for over 200 years.

For the most part, Ibuki is, in reality, a kind individual. So long as she may permanently reside in her forest, she is happy. Lest anything causes harm to anything in Avidya Forest, Ibuki will then harm them. Otherwise, she has no problem with humans and mononoke. While she's with Monjumaru, the two are rather sappy with each other and a loving couple in general. ~!After years with Monjumaru, the mutually agreed to make him undying. Ibuki gave half of her power as a mononoke to him, making him immortal and a half-mononoke.!~ ~!Ibuki has met many mononoke in her years, most notably Amagi. Luckily, he did not cause any harm and instead just voiced his disdain for her lifestyle. In present time, Ibuki has helped Jirou Azuma get a grasp on Ragou's power implanted in him, and successfully trains him as much as she and Monjumaru could.!~

node.description:
One of Amagi's many followers, Roren is a mononoke capable of masterful illusions. Compared to others of his kind, he isn't particularly powerful in a brawl; however, when using his illusions, he can enhance himself or cause disadvantages for others to gain the upper hand. Generally wields a flag while using his powers, and is also able to hold up a barrier on top of his trickery.

Roren, for the most part, hates humans, saying they make him want to vomit. He'll make no attempt to hide his disgust for humans, and more often is smug about everything, even going as far as trying to embarrass some with his illusions. In general, Roren is a self-centered hedonist, not having much ambitions for himself. Despite this, he does later awaken a liking to being dominated, primarily enjoying cold and sadistic women. Upon this discovery, Roren becomes a pushover to sadism. Additionally, he begins to enjoy parts of human culture, such as music and fashion. He also wears some form of mask all the time, be it a gas mask or a standard surgical mask. Why he chooses to is unknown. ~!Roren discovered his like for sadistic women after being defeated by Ichika Kishimojin. As he was getting pushed around by her, he started to enjoy it and, to Ichika's dismay, fell in love with her. Luckily for her, she can use it to get information or help from him for the Bureau.!~ ~!Even though Roren was a part of Amagi's cause, he never actually believed in it, and instead was just keeping an eye on the situation. As he was captured by the Bureau, he joined forces with them, still acting as a spy. Though Roren does watch what's going on, he will side with either side that has a better prospect, for a while, at least.!~

Yutaka Yamada is a Los Angeles-based music composer known for his work on the anime television series "Tokyo Ghoul", "VINLAND SAGA" and major Japanese films such as "Death Note:Light Up the New World", "BLEACH" and "KINDGOM". His masterpiece soundtracks for "Tokyo Ghoul" have gained worldwide popularity with related videos totaling over 70 million views on Youtube.

In 2018, Yamada composed for "Cry Me a Sad River", a Chinese film which had succeeded with USD $51Mil. In the same year, Eminem sampled Yamada's master piece "Glassy Sky (from "Tokyo Ghoul")" on his song "Good Guy" in his "Kamikaze" album. 
In 2019, he has worked alongside Sony Pictures for their mega-hit live-action film "KINGDOM" in which he received nomination for the 43rd Japan Academy Film Prize for Best Music Score. WIT Studio, famous for producing "Attack on Titan", released their most anticipated animation series "VINLAND SAGA", with an original soundtrack composed entirely by Yamada. 

Born in 1989, Yamada graduated from Senzoku Gakuen College of Music where he passionately studied musical composition. In 2009, he entered and won the first prize at VIENNA INSTRUMENTS Strings Arrangement Contest.

Today, he is represented by Soundtrack Music Associates, and has since relocated his production base from Tokyo to Sonic Fuel Studios in Los Angeles.

As maidens from the Five Clans battle for the Crown Prince’s heart, jealous Keigetsu uses forbidden magic to swap bodies with the beloved Reirin. Switching places does not guarantee happiness for Keigetsu with her new body's ill health leaving her hanging on the verge of death. Meanwhile, Reirin, now wearing the face of a scorned outcast, must answer for Keigetsu’s crimes in a dangerous trial.

The unlikely pair become increasingly entangled in each other’s lives and they will need to work together to survive after discovering the dark conspiracies brewing beneath the palace's genial surface. To confront the deadly threats lurking in the shadows, Reirin must embrace her new identity and defy their expectations of the court's inept villainess.

__Introduction:__
Ai Kayano is a Japanese voice actress and vocalist currently affiliated with Office Osawa.

__Biography:__
Kayano wanted to work in a job that would involve "healing people", leading to initially take up a course at a vocational school. She worked in the beauty industry and became interested in acting after having seen [Aria](https://anilist.co/anime/477/). While attending school, Kayano continued working in the industry and paid for her tuition.

Kayano began working at Pro-Fit in 2010, voicing two supporting characters in the original video animation [Princess Resurrection](https://anilist.co/anime/9159/). In 2011, she voiced [Meiko "Menma" Honma](https://anilist.co/character/40592/) in [Anohana](https://anilist.co/anime/9989/) and received the Best Rookie Actress award for said role at the 6th Seiyuu Awards. Kayano, [Haruka Tomatsu](https://anilist.co/staff/95890/) and [Saori Hayami](https://anilist.co/staff/95869/) performed the series' ending theme "Secret Base – Kimi ga Kureta Mono (10 years after Ver.)", a cover of a song originally sung by the band Zone.

She is often praised for her vocal range, having voiced a variety of characters such as [Mayaka Ibara](https://anilist.co/character/55137/), [Mashiro Shiina](https://anilist.co/character/61371/), [Darkness](https://anilist.co/character/89363/) and [Akari Kawamoto](https://anilist.co/character/24311/) for example, none of which one would connect to the same voice actress.

__Introduction:__
Eve is a Japanese utaite, mangaka, fashion designer, vocalist, guitarist, lyricist and composer under record label TOY'S FACTORY (2019–), having previously been under record label harapeco records (2016–2018). He works closely with the arranger [Tomoki Numano](https://anilist.co/staff/137906/Tomoki-Numano), otherwise known as Numa, who arranges most of his songs.

__Biography:__
He first started uploading covers on NicoNico Douga in April 2009 at the age of 13. Aside from covering songs, he was one of the lead singers for the Japanese indie band einie, alongside Natsushiro Takaaki; he also composed songs and wrote lyrics for the band. 

He started going by the name Eve in October 2009; before that, he had gone by the names Keitora and Kurowa. He also plays the acoustic guitar and sometimes accompanies his songs with his own acoustic arrangements.

tags.name: Proxy Battle
tags.description: A proxy battle is a battle where humans use creatures/robots to do the fighting for them, either by commanding those creatures/robots or by simply evolving them/changing them into battle mode.

tags.name: Urban
tags.description: Partly or completely set in a city.

tags.name: Artificial Intelligence
tags.description: Intelligent non-organic machines that work and react similarly to humans.

tags.name: Found Family
tags.description: Features a group of characters with no biological relations that are united in a group providing social support.

tags.name: Primarily Teen Cast
tags.description: Main cast is mostly composed of teen characters.

tags.name: Dystopian
tags.description: Partly or completely set in a society characterized by poverty, squalor or oppression.

tags.name: Male Protagonist
tags.description: Main character is male.

tags.name: Anthropomorphism
tags.description: Contains non-human character(s) that have attributes or characteristics of a human being.

tags.name: Ensemble Cast
tags.description: Features a large cast of characters with (almost) equal screen time and importance to the plot.

tags.name: Conspiracy
tags.description: Contains one or more factions controlling or attempting to control the world from the shadows.

tags.name: Creature Taming
tags.description: Features the taming of animals, monsters, or other creatures.

tags.name: Urban Fantasy
tags.description: Set in a world similar to the real world, but with the existence of magic or other supernatural elements.

tags.name: Criminal Organization
tags.description: Prominently features a group of people who commit crimes for illicit or violent purposes.

tags.name: Animals
tags.description: Prominently features animal characters in a leading role.

tags.name: Virtual World
tags.description: Partly or completely set in the world inside a video game.

tags.name: Kids
tags.description: Target demographic is young children.

tags.name: Episodic
tags.description: Features story arcs that are loosely tied or lack an overarching plot.

tags.name: Henshin
tags.description: Prominently features character or costume transformations which often grant special abilities.

tags.name: Class Struggle
tags.description: Contains conflict born between the different social classes. Generally between an dominant elite and a suffering oppressed group.

tags.name: Cyberpunk
tags.description: Set in a future of advanced technological and scientific achievements that have resulted in social disorder.

tags.name: Terrorism
tags.description: Centers around the activities of a terrorist or terrorist organization.

tags.name: Food
tags.description: Centers around cooking or food appraisal.

tags.name: Kaiju
tags.description: Prominently features giant monsters.

tags.name: Orphan
tags.description: Prominently features a character that is an orphan.

tags.name: Super Power
tags.description: Prominently features characters with special abilities that allow them to do what would normally be physically or logically impossible.

tags.name: Suicide
tags.description: The act or an instance of taking or attempting to take one's own life voluntarily and intentionally.

tags.name: Tomboy
tags.description: Features a girl who exhibits characteristics or behaviors considered in many cultures to be typical of boys.

tags.name: Augmented Reality

A Japanese voice actress and singer-songwriter under entertainment agency Axlone (2017–) and record label King Records (2015–), having previously been under entertainment agency Sony Music Entertainment (2010–2017). She has been active as a voice actor since 2010, debuting in the anime Occult Academy voicing the character Akari Okamoto, while debuting as a singer-songwriter in December 2015.

Inori was born in Tokyo, where she began watching anime in kindergarten. She first became aware of voice acting when, after watching a stage play adaptation of an anime, she read the stage pamphlet and asked her parents about a person mentioned in it. She found out that she wanted to become a voice actor at the age of six, and in elementary school, she listed voice acting as her desired future career. 

In middle school, Inori joined her school's tennis and theater clubs; however, she quit the theater club due to feeling too embarrassed when appearing on stage. Around the same time, her mother found a magazine advertising a voice-acting audition, which she participated in and won.

Atsumi Tanezaki is a Japanese voice actress who is formerly affiliated with the Toritori Office, and is now represented by Haikyo.

She began to study voice acting at a training school after graduating from high school in her home prefecture, Oita, using funds she had gathered from several part-time jobs.

Upon expressing her desire to become a voice actress at a fan event, Iwao responded stating that she looked forward to being able to work with her.

__Introduction:__
Tatsuya Kitani is a Japanese vocalist, bassist, guitarist, composer, arranger and programmer. He is also known as a Vocaloid song producer, going under the name Konnichiwa Tanita-san/Hello Tanita-san.

__Biography:__
Tatsuya started publishing music on the Internet around 2014. Later in 2017, he would start performing solo activities, while providing music as a lyricist. In 2018, he would form the band [Sajou no Hana](https://anilist.co/staff/137163) (stylized as sajou no hana) with members [Sana](https://anilist.co/staff/296329) and [Shou Watanabe](https://anilist.co/staff/109345).

[Website](https://www.office-augusta.com/regallily/) | [Twitter](https://x.com/regal__lily) | [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/regallily_official/) | [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@regallily_official) | [Youtube](https://www.youtube.com/@Regallily_official)

Regal Lily is a two-member female band from Tokyo, Japan. Influenced by romanticism and existential literature from the likes of Shuntaro Tanikawa and Kenji Miyazawa, Regal Lily describes their music as "fragile" with a "whirlpool of sound". Their songs are a mix of shoegaze-pop combined with powerful guitar distortions and chaotic drumming. Lead singer Honoka has listed My Bloody Valentine and Shonen Knife as her musical inspirations.

The band formed in 2014 when vocalist-guitarist [Honoka Takahashi](https://anilist.co/staff/370077) met drummer Yukiyama while in high school. The girls performed at small shows and festivals at the time before gaining a small following after winning second place for their music at the 2015 Mikakunin Festival competition for teen rock bands. Bassist Umi, who played supporting bass since 2017, officially joined the band in 2018.

Regal Lily quickly gained fame with their unique sound and shy stage presence. They performed at SXSW in 2019 for the official Japan Nite showcase, attracting many international fans. Their single "ハナヒカリ" ("Hanahikari") was featured in the "Flowers of Evil" (orig. 惡の華/Aku no Hana) live-action movie, released in 2019. The music video for their February 2020 song "ハンシー" ("Hansie") featured up-and-coming actress Sakurako Konishi, and was chosen as a commercial jingle for the Bank of Iwate on April 2020.

Japanese voice actress affiliated with Mausu Promotion.

Fairouz was born to a Japanese mother and an Egyptian father. She was named after the Lebanese singer, Fairuz. She spent a few years of her elementary education in Cairo before returning to Japan. During her junior high school years, she became familiar with the manga series [JoJo's Bizarre Adventure](https://anilist.co/manga/31517/). Due to her growing interest in the series, she would join Skype reading sessions with other fans. Eventually, she was inspired to pursue a career in voice acting, but her parents initially disapproved of her plans. Instead, she would initially study at a graphic design vocational school before spending a year as a dental assistant. Once she was able to save enough money for tuition, she enrolled in a voice acting training school.

In 2019, she debuted as [Hibiki Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/132856/), the protagonist of the anime series [How Heavy Are the Dumbbells You Lift?](https://anilist.co/anime/107226/)

In a Twitter post on 31st December 2024 she announced her indefinite hiatus from voice acting due to health complications surrounding PTSD. On April 1st, she announced she would be returning from hiatus, and that she would be leaving Raccoon Dog for talent agency Mausu Promotion.

__Awards:__
- Best New Actress at the 14th Seiyuu Awards in 2020 for her role as [Hibiki Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/132856/Hibiki-Sakura).

Ultimately, he resolves himself to be faithful and protective of the ones that he cares most about.

Japanese voice actress affiliated with Mausu Promotion.

Fairouz was born to a Japanese mother and an Egyptian father. She was named after the Lebanese singer, Fairuz. She spent a few years of her elementary education in Cairo before returning to Japan. During her junior high school years, she became familiar with the manga series [JoJo's Bizarre Adventure](https://anilist.co/manga/31517/). Due to her growing interest in the series, she would join Skype reading sessions with other fans. Eventually, she was inspired to pursue a career in voice acting, but her parents initially disapproved of her plans. Instead, she would initially study at a graphic design vocational school before spending a year as a dental assistant. Once she was able to save enough money for tuition, she enrolled in a voice acting training school.

In 2019, she debuted as [Hibiki Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/132856/), the protagonist of the anime series [How Heavy Are the Dumbbells You Lift?](https://anilist.co/anime/107226/)

In a Twitter post on 31st December 2024 she announced her indefinite hiatus from voice acting due to health complications surrounding PTSD. On April 1st, she announced she would be returning from hiatus, and that she would be leaving Raccoon Dog for talent agency Mausu Promotion.

Koyasu is the most prolific voice actor in the industry, having been credited for over 700 roles as of April 2022.

Growing up, Koyasu skipped out on going to school to watch movies at home because he wanted to become an actor. It wasn’t until later that he became interested in voice acting after having seen [Galaxy Express 999](https://anilist.co/anime/1491/). After graduation he entered a voice acting school. In 1988, he made his voice acting debut, and got his first regular role a year later voicing [Gai](https://anilist.co/character/13374/) in [Tenkuu Senki Shurato](https://anilist.co/anime/2113/).

Though having voiced more characters in the medium than anyone else, he is probably most known for his role as [Dio Brando](https://anilist.co/character/4004/) in [JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure](https://anilist.co/anime/14719/). He has stated that he likes playing villainous characters.

Koyasu has taken over many of [Kaneto Shiozawa](https://anilist.co/staff/95424/)’s roles after Shiozawa’s passing.

node.description:
Roy Alphard is a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing the bizarre eating aspect of gluttony. 
He has long disheveled brown hair, with green eyes that are yellow are the center and teeth shaped like sharp fangs. He wears a small piece of cloth around his body as clothing.


Unlike his brother Lye, Roy doesn’t care about what he consumes nor does he place any special emphasis on who he wants to eat like his sister Louis. As “bizarre eating” of gluttony, his approach towards his meals is much more casual, emphasizing quantity over quality. In combat unlike Lye he does not give his opponents a chance and likes to exploit their weaknesses to completely destroy them. 


~! 
Like Lye and Louis, Roy has two similar skills shared between the gluttony’s 

Roy has access to “Authority of Gluttony”, unlike other types of authority there are different forms and effects that come from being affected by the authority.

Roy can eat a name and memories of an individual. To achieve eating a name he touches the individual with his left hand, then licks the palm of the same hand. Roy can then take things such as experience, talent, likes and dislikes of human relationships and they can serve as food for him, allowing him to take advantage of any abilities or memories his opponents had. 

Those that have their names eaten have their existences erased from the world. This will end any human relationships and remove any contracts with spirits
Those who have their memories eaten become amnesic and any types of characteristics they had previous are removed.
Those who have their name and memories eaten become an empty shell, while they are still alive they no longer require the need to eat,excrete waste or age. 

While this ability is powerful on paper it has two major drawbacks

If Roy eats a fake name or memory he will become plagued with severe nausea.
Roy is also unable to eat the same person twice until that individual has gained enough new memories or has established a different sense of self from their old existence.  

!~

__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")

Julius Euclius is [Anastasia Hoshin's](https://anilist.co/character/90177/Hoshin-Anastasi) knight and a member of the Royal Guard. Julius lived with his family at the Euclius House. After his father, Klein Euclius died, he started to live with his uncle Alviero and he started to take care of Julius and became his adoptive father.

As a member of Lugnica's nobility, Julius acts in a proper fashion, always having an air of nobility and conviction. He is also considerate and doesn't forget to show care toward others. He also shows a strict side, giving out accurate assessments of others whether they're good or bad, which is a result of his upbringing as an elite, and in actuality, he believes that he and others can do better than they currently are.

Julius doesn't like those who forget their place, leading him to have bad relations with [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) for a while. While both have apologized to each other after the battle with the Hakugei, Subaru told him he still hated him. Julius said he didn't intend to be friends. They both became very intimate very quickly during the planning and attacking the Witch Cult. In the end, Julius directly considered Subaru as his friend.

As the Sword Saint and the Knight of the Royal Guard, Reinhard embodies chivalry and elegance, treating everyone with exceptional respect. He is fair, brave, and always acts in the name of justice, whether on duty or simply strolling through the Royal Capital.

As a knight, Reinhard only uses his sword when necessary, since, in addition to being a rule, his iron-clad rule is to not inflict pain to others if not absolutely necessary, be it a normal thug or a member of the Witch Cult.

Konomi Suzuki is a Japanese singer from Osaka Prefecture who is signed to Amuleto. After winning the Animax All-Japan Anisong Grand Prix in 2011, she made her debut in 2012 with the release of her first single "Choir Jail", which peaked at 34 on the Oricon charts; the title track of which was used as the opening theme to the anime television series Dusk Maiden of Amnesia. She released her first album 17, in 2014, two albums in 2015, and a further album Lead, in 2016.

Suzuki cites the character Sheryl Nome from Macross Frontier as her inspiration for making music for anime. Her music has been featured in anime series such as The Pet Girl of Sakurasou, No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!, No Game No Life, and Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World. She has also performed in events in Japan such as Animelo Summer Live and Animax Musix, and at international events in China, Germany, the United States, and Southeast Asia. In 2018, Suzuki made her voice acting debut, playing the role of Rin in the anime television series Lost Song.

Xanthe Huynh is an American voice-actress of Vietnamese descent. Huynh's path to acting began during a course in theatre acting during an elective course while in middle school. She fell in love with acting and continued on the acting path throughout high school and her passion eventually led to her graduating with a degree in Dramatic Arts at the University of Irvine in California. 

Huynh also enjoyed anime as a hobby and confided in her friends if there was any way to combine her two loves. Her friends were supportive of the idea and pushed her to try out for Anime Expo's voice acting competition called AX Idol. She would eventually make it as a finalist and was invited to audition for, and eventually signed with Bang Zoom! Entertainment and is still currently working for them since 2008, and is currently based in Los Angeles, California. 

Since signing, Huynh has gone on to voice minor and major character roles in anime and video games in major productions. Besides voice acting, Huynh also enjoys cosplaying, which is proudly displayed on her Instagram.

Anon Chihaya is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the rhythm guitarist of [MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/).

Anon is an honor student who is very social and also assertive at the same time. Despite this, it is shown that she has had a hard time making friends. Anon also loves following and trying out the newest trends. She approaches [Tomori](https://anilist.co/character/302095/Takamatsu-Tomori) after learning about her in hopes of creating a band together with her. Although she initially created the band in order to gain attention, to the point where she wanted to name the band after herself, she ends up becoming dedicated to her band activities and taking practicing seriously.

**Height:** 155 cm

Tomori Takamatsu is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the vocalist and lyricist of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)**.

Tomori is a kind but sensitive girl who has an awkward personality. She has a tendency to stutter while talking and not make eye contact. She also tends to blame herself for the conflicts that happen around her, even if they weren't caused by her.

She is infamously known as "Haneoka's Weirdo Girl" due to her peculiar personality. She likes collecting all sorts of things, such as band-aids (especially ones with animals such as pandas or penguins on them), slippery things, just-the-right-size things, and even rocks and fallen leaves that she picks up from the ground. She also likes pill bugs and has been shown often drawing them in her notebooks.
